svg.text: Concepts for review — pick a direction (or tell me what you like in each).
The O of Open is a chat bubble with a face
A friendly padlock, shackle up: nothing
You in front, a friend behind
Rounded frame left open for the online dot
Voice-first: the friend you hang out with
A cupped face with arms raised: welcome in
A chat bubble split like a door left ajar:
The old infinity favicon, now looking back
